messages:
sara_sales: Ping — Saybrook (pilot) wants a 2-week POC to validate a move off their current vendor. Main asks: prompt parity, structured JSON output parity, pricing comparison, and completed security questionnaire. They attached a PDF (link).

mike_se: Quick q — do they use streaming now or just batch completions? And what are their typical qps during spikes?

sara_sales: They stream for chat (client-side UI). Avg 10 qps, spikes to ~50 qps during marketing events. They want P50 <150ms for simple completion endpoints.

ashley_soleng: I'll put together a tiny translation shim to map their API fields to ours. Plan:
- map header X-Model -> model param
- translate "stop": ["\\n\\n"] -> stop param
- normalize sampling params (temperature/top_p)

Code snippet:
```
# shim example (node-ish psuedo)
fetch('/proxy/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'authorization': 'Bearer ' + token,
    'content-type': 'application/json',
    'x-competitor-model': 'goliath-3'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: userPrompt })
})

// proxy -> maps header to { model: 'redwood-3b', temperature: 0.2 }
```

ashley_soleng: Note: competitor pins seeds for deterministic outputs. We can approximate by lowering temperature & top_p but exact parity won't be perfect. Will annotate variance expectations.

alex_security: From sec side, checklist items we need to confirm:
- SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning (supported on Dedicated/Private)
- VPC peering & private control plane (Private supports, needs network review)
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM (yes for Private)
- Data residency (Saybrook requires EU at-rest)
- Provide SOC2 report + ISO cert links
I'll prepare the QA answers and the redacted attachments.

raj_engineering: For testing parity, propose A/B harness: run their 500 seed prompts through both vendor and our shim (side-by-side). Capture:
- token counts
- stop/tokenization differences
- structured JSON fields (key presence/order)
- embedding/semantic similarity (cosine)
We'll produce pass/fail buckets with examples for ask/style mismatches.

jordan_csm: Pricing note: propose a POC credit of $4k covering initial runs; if they commit to Dedicated, offer a short-term onboarding discount. Rough usage calc: 500 prompts * 150 tokens avg * 2 variants * 10 runs/day ~ 1.5M tokens -> ~= $300 at hosted list. We'll formalize a POC SKUs + trial SLA.

sara_sales: Action items:
- @ashley_soleng: deliver shim + mapping doc by EOD today
- @raj_engineering: kick off A/B harness and share initial metrics in 48h
- @alex_security: complete security QA draft and confirm EU residency options
- @jordan_csm: draft POC terms & pricing and script for kickoff call

deploy-bot: provision:dedicated-trial saybrook-poc -> 1xA10G (expires in 14 days) :white_check_mark:

mike_se: I'll set up an intro call with Saybrook for tomorrow. Need a 10–15min demo of streaming differences and a short explanation of stop-token behavior.

ashley_soleng: Will include streaming demo + notes on chunking and reconnection idempotency. Also will upload sample curl mapping.

sara_sales: Thanks — I'll share the questionnaire PDF and the contact list for Saybrook. Will cc on the invite.
